evidence.name: Screen field: Slide headline
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Slide headline" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Slide headline
sections.description: The main headline on this slide, shown only when the slide template includes a title. Keep it short and benefit-led so it lands in the few seconds the slide is on screen. You can drop in the visitor's earlier answers with @variable, plus countdown timers and styled label chips; if your funnel runs in several languages, you edit this text per language.
